summary: Crown PropTech Acquisitions, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting that the SEC declared effective on November 4, 2026 the Form F-4 registration statement (File No. 333-296089) covering its business combination with Mkango Rare Earths Limited (MKAR, a BVI company) and affiliates of Mkango Magnetic Materials Limited. The original agreement was signed July 2, 2025 and amended and restated September 2, 2026. Crown commenced mailing the definitive proxy statement/prospectus on November 5, 2026. No price, premium or valuation terms appear in the excerpt. Watch the shareholder vote and redemption levels, which determine deal funding.
